# `compat/surface/surface-manager.js`

> **Source:** `engine/compat/surface/surface-manager.js`

surface/surface-manager.js — pick the presentation surface for a guest. Selected by `profile.gpu.presentation`. `webgpu-canvas` (and `canvas-2d`) are implemented. `offscreen` requires an explicit worker renderer module; `engine-texture` requires a host-compositor factory. Missing prerequisites fall back to the ordinary canvas surface without claiming support.
